adoption.rationale: The pinned SPA helper reads the non-HttpOnly XSRF-TOKEN cookie into the hidden csrfToken field of the native OAuth consent POST. The exact route is mounted in the JSON entrypoint with CsrfGuard; middleware falls back to the csrfToken form field and compares it to the session token with hash_equals. issueToken produces a 40-character lowercase-hex value using bin2hex(random_bytes(20)). The contract asks only that the capture body cannot absorb a cookie separator; the exact-source Node replay checks complete helper behavior and an exact capture-widening mutation.

contract.declared_domain: The formal proof covers every single ASCII character admitted by the exact capture body [^;], without a length bound. The exact-pin product replay covers server-issued 40-character lowercase-hex tokens in semicolon-separated document.cookie strings with exactly one XSRF-TOKEN pair, placed first, between neighboring cookies, and last; decodeURIComponent must leave these server-issued tokens unchanged. The replay mutates the exact pinned capture body to (.*) and checks that a following cookie pair is then included. The proof models the capture body only; it does not formalize JavaScript RegExp search or duplicate cookie-name ordering.
contract.guarantee: The captured value for the XSRF-TOKEN cookie cannot include a semicolon, so it cannot absorb a following cookie pair into the csrfToken submitted by the OAuth consent form.
contract.input_source: The browser document.cookie string read by getCsrfTokenFromCookie for the OAuth application consent form. The server creates the session token with bin2hex(random_bytes(20)), exposes it in the XSRF-TOKEN cookie, and the hidden csrfToken form field is checked by CsrfGuard against the session value with hash_equals.

domain: The exact pinned capture body [^;] admits no ASCII semicolon; the product gate separately replays complete JavaScript helper behavior
name: XC-xibo-csrf-cookie-capture-isolation
